description: Dead-UI gate catalog: TEA Msg enums whose variants must each have a construction site outside the declaration file. Waivers carry a reason and ratchet down. See tools/moui/validate_dead_messages.

waivers.reason: Platform-owned window request kept in the message protocol for native hosts; the immersive shell uses the system traffic lights instead of self-drawn buttons (see memories/repo/moui-studio.md), so no view constructs it.
Same as WindowClose: reserved for the platform window-request protocol, deliberately not self-drawn.
WindowRequest has no zoom/maximize variant, so a self-drawn zoom button would be dead UI; the variant stays declared for protocol symmetry.
Window dragging is a platform-local concern (docs/invariants.md P10) routed through WindowDragRegionSource, not a queued WindowRequest.

M5-5e code-view appearance toggle (MoonBit ⇄ DSL) kept as update-covered protocol: the update arm and wbtests exercise the transition while the view-side entry is pending re-wiring after the code pane refactor.

Form-designer drag commit protocol added with the form canvas contract (65d7b60d6): the update arm applies the span patch and form_design_canvas.mbt documents the dispatch point; the canvas pointer-gesture wiring is still in flight.
Same in-flight form-designer gesture protocol as FormDesignDragEnd (resize commit counterpart).

Terminal input protocol message: the update arm dispatches the PtyService write effect and app_test covers it; production input currently routes through the kernel PtyService while the view-side send path is being migrated (M9 terminal work).
Terminal typed-input protocol message, same in-flight migration as TerminalInput.
